# Enemy communication intercepted.
[bold][color=crimson]Traitors[/color][/bold] are sleeper agents embedded in the crew by [bold][color=maroon]The Syndicate[/color][/bold] on behalf of its member groups. [break]Tasked with a range of objectives to impair the Station's operation, Traitors work from the inside to give NanoTrasen a death by a thousand cuts— or bullet wounds, for that matter.
Activating shortly after the start of the shift, [bold][color=crimson]Traitors[/color][/bold] must familiarize themselves with their objectives, identify eachother, and gear up before getting to work. [break]Pressing [bold][color=yellow][keybind="OpenCharacterMenu"][/color] opens your Character Menu[/bold] which lists your objectives, codewords, and uplink code. [break]Your [bold]objectives[/bold] will update their progress every time you open the character menu. [break][bold]Codewords[/bold] are shared by all [bold][color=crimson]Traitors[/color][/bold], they will be automatically highlighted in chat, letting you trade words and knowing glances. [break]Your [bold]uplink code[/bold] can be entered as a PDA's ringtone to link it to a store with everything you will need to finish the job.
## Victory conditions The [bold]Round Summary[/bold] is going to outline details of the operation, including the codewords, who the Traitors were & what they had to do, and [bold]which side won[/bold]. [break]Victory is decided based on [bold]objective completion[/bold], and how many Traitors are "taken out", that is— restrained or dead. [break]Abstractly, victory is defined by which side got in the other's way more.
- [bold][color=crimson]Traitor Major Victory[/color][/bold] [break]All objectives are complete, and at least one Traitor is alive and free.
- [bold][color=crimson]Traitor Minor Victory[/color][/bold] [break]More than half of all objectives are complete, and at least one Traitor is left standing.
- [bold][color=yellow]Neutral Outcome[/color][/bold] [break]Less than half of all objectives are complete, and at least one Traitor is left standing.
- [bold][color=green]Crew Minor Victory[/color][/bold] [break]All Traitors are dead or in custody, but all objectives are complete too.
- [bold][color=green]Crew Major Victory[/color][/bold] [break]All Traitors are dead or in custody, and at least one objective is left incomplete.
## Tools of the trade Every Traitor gets their own [bold]uplink balance[/bold] of [bold][color=crimson]20 Telecrystals[/color][/bold] to spend on purchases [break]Every PDA can be [bold]backdoored[/bold] by entering an [bold]uplink code[/bold] as the ringtone. This will open a store with the balance associated with that code. [break]Telecrystals can be [bold]withdrawn and transfered[/bold] between open uplinks, in case you want to share. [break]If you activate without a PDA, you will find yourself with an [bold]uplink implant[/bold] and its cost subtracted from your balance.
The uplink is divided into several categories.
The Syndicate doesn't provide refunds, so you must choose wisely and use it before you lose it.
## Tasks at hand Every Traitor gets a group of objectives they have to complete before the end of the round. [break]Groups are put together as a few tough objectives, many easy objectives, or somewhere inbetween. [break]It's a good idea to try and enlist the help of your fellow Traitors for tougher objectives you can't do yourself, your team depends on a flawless victory!
You may be tasked with [bold]stealing the gear[/bold] of Command members present on the station. How you get it is up to you, but make sure it stays with you after.
You may be tasked with [bold]sabotaging[/bold] an important machine in some department. You will find a bespoke sabotage tool in your [bold]uplink[/bold] for free, in their own category. [break]You must then remove the machine's maintenance panels with tools or by force, and insert the tool. [break]This will start a timer until the sabotage completes, and [bold]alert the relevant people[/bold], either the department, or [bold]The Whole Station[/bold] if it's that significant. [break]Get ready to defend the tool while it's doing its work, don't let it get removed too soon.
[bold]You won't be tasked with harming your own department.[/bold]
